spans.s: चष् (II) vt. 1P (pres. चषति) To kill, to injure.
चषक (I) m.n. 1. A vessel used for drinking spirits, a wine-glass, च्युतैः शिरस्त्रैश्चषकोत्तरेव R.vii.49, or मुखं लालाक्लिन्नं पिबति चषकं सासावामिव Sant.S.ii.29.
चषक (II) n. 1. a kind of spirituous liquor; 2. honey.
चषाल m. 1. A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post; 2. a hive.
चाष m. The blue jay, Yaj.i.175.
